categories.main_business_segments: Yunnan Aluminium Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the aluminum industry, encompassing bauxite mining, alumina refining, green aluminum production, aluminum processing, and carbon products manufacturing. The company has three reportable segments: alumina segment (bauxite mining and alumina production), primary aluminum segment (electrolytic aluminum production, carbon products, aluminum alloys), and other operations including logistics and alumina trading.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced green aluminum integrated production technologies, including photovoltaic direct current access for electrolytic aluminum power, large-scale electrolytic cell maintenance residue harmless and resource utilization, and aluminum ash resource recycling production lines. It emphasizes energy-saving and carbon-reduction technologies, such as low-temperature aluminum electrolysis, new continuous anode electrolysis cells, inert anode aluminum electrolysis, and comprehensive utilization of electrolytic aluminum solid waste. The company also has a strong R&D system with multiple provincial key laboratories and technology centers focusing on green aluminum materials and resource recycling.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yunnan Aluminium serves a broad range of industries including automotive lightweighting, rail transit, aerospace, defense, packaging, furniture, power electronics, and 3C electronics. Its products, such as electrolytic aluminum, aluminum alloys, and carbon products, are widely used in these sectors. The company has established stable upstream and downstream supply chain relationships with many well-known domestic and international enterprises, leveraging its green aluminum brand.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with production bases and mining operations concentrated in Yunnan Province, including Kunming, Wenshan, Zhaotong, and other locations. It benefits from Yunnan's abundant green hydropower resources. The company also leverages its strategic location near the South and Southeast Asian markets, facilitated by infrastructure like the China-Laos railway and the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP).
categories.supply_chain_position: Yunnan Aluminium operates an integrated upstream to midstream supply chain, covering bauxite mining, alumina refining, electrolytic aluminum production, aluminum alloy manufacturing, and carbon products essential for aluminum electrolysis. It also engages in downstream aluminum processing and recycling activities, positioning itself as a full-chain green aluminum producer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes green, low-carbon, and integrated aluminum production, focusing on energy efficiency, carbon footprint reduction, and resource recycling. R&D efforts target advanced aluminum alloys for transportation and aerospace, aluminum ash and red mud resource utilization, and intelligent manufacturing with digital and AI technologies. It aims to develop high-end aluminum products and breakthrough energy-saving electrolysis technologies, supporting national carbon peak and neutrality goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of aluminum products including electrolytic aluminum, aluminum alloys, alumina, and carbon products. The company also earns income from logistics services and trading activities related to alumina. Sales are conducted mainly through direct sales channels within China.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yunnan Aluminium is one of China's largest green aluminum producers and the leading supplier of green low-carbon aluminum domestically. It holds a unique position as the only integrated aluminum company in China certified across the entire chain by ASI standards. Its main competitors are other large Chinese aluminum producers, but Yunnan Aluminium differentiates itself through its green energy advantage and integrated production model.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 54.45 billion, a 27.61% increase from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 4.41 billion, up 11.52%. Total assets reached RMB 41.9 billion, with net assets of RMB 28.32 billion. The company has shown steady growth in production volumes and profitability, maintaining a strong financial position with a focus on sustainable development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yunnan Aluminium emphasizes its green aluminum brand, leveraging abundant clean hydropower to produce aluminum with significantly lower carbon emissions (about 20% of coal-powered aluminum). It offers a full integrated green aluminum supply chain from bauxite to finished products, certified by international sustainability standards. The company focuses on high-quality, high-purity, and high-performance aluminum products tailored for emerging applications in automotive lightweighting, aerospace, and electronics, supported by strong R&D and resource recycling capabilities.
